content: {"like":["Great voices of the era such as Renata Tebaldi, Ettore Bastianini, Franco Corelli, Oralia Domínguez, Boris Christoff, Renato Capecchi, Leontyne Price, Giuseppe Giacomini, Leo Nucci, Bonaldo Giaiotti, Isola Jones, Anthony Laciura, Plácido Domingo, Mirella Freni, Giorgio Zancanaro, Paul Plishka, Sesto Bruscantini, Giorgio Surian, Dolora Zajic, Renata Scotto, Susanne Marsee","Charming and graceful stage presence of Tebaldi, magnificent performance of Bastianini, thrilling voice of Corelli, delightful portrayal of Domínguez, marvelous Slavic voice of Christoff, excellent Fra Melitone by Capecchi, admirable simplicity and sincerity of Price’s acting, flamboyant portrayal by Nucci, satisfying performance of Giaiotti, sultry Preziosilla by Isola Jones, finest characterizations by Laciura, electrifying EMI recording conducted by Riccardo Muti, iconic Leonora of Callas, scintillating Preziosilla of Marsee"],"dislike":["Provincial production with unknown stage director and old sets","Lack of linear intensity and flat, yelp‑like high notes in Tebaldi’s performance","Christoff’s expressionless delivery and clownish wig/false beard","Capecchi’s traditional false‑nose","Subtitles confusing friars with monks","Terrible production overall with non‑existent direction","Misapplied Method in modern singers","Metropolitan Opera production not representative of Dexter’s work","Price’s vocalism with scoops, whoops, and parodistic effect","Acting descending into parody by Act III","Giacomini’s lack of stage presence","Extreme close‑ups serving no one well","Exaggerated Melitone portrayal"]}
